description: National  Medical Regulatory Authority - Notify the Prices Regulations 2018 under the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, No. 05 of 2015. 1.The Ceiling of Prices 2. Medicines (Tender Prices)  3. Medical Devices Pricing.
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, specifically amending price control regulations for medicines. It establishes legal/regulatory frameworks for maximum retail prices of pharmaceutical products, which falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves regulatory amendments and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes or specialized non-governmental administrative matters.
